# Compass

> > Compass is a luxury real estate platform connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with top agents across major US markets, powered by proprietary technology and exclusive listings.

Compass operates a comprehensive real estate marketplace featuring home buying, selling, and rental services alongside neighborhood guides and agent networks. The platform specializes in luxury properties, new developments, and exclusive pre-market listings across markets like San Francisco, Silicon Valley, and Chicago.

## Key Topics

- Real Estate Listings
- Home Selling
- Luxury Properties
- Neighborhood Guides
- San Francisco Real Estate
- Coming Soon Listings
- Private Exclusives
- Real Estate Agents
- New Developments
- Silicon Valley
- Property Search
- Marketing Strategy
- Concierge Services
- Apartment Rentals

## Core Services

- [Compass Home](https://www.compass.com): Compass homepage for buying, selling, and renting homes with agents
- [Sell Your Home](https://www.compass.com/sell): Home selling services with Compass 3-Phase Marketing Strategy
- [Private Exclusives](https://www.compass.com/private-exclusives): Private exclusive listings and pre-market homes with Compass agents
- [Coming Soon Listings](https://www.compass.com/coming-soon/listings): Exclusive coming soon listings in San Jose with private tours

## Property Search & Listings

- [San Jose Real Estate](https://www.compass.com/compass-listings): San Jose real estate listings with exclusive collections and tours
- [New Home Developments](https://www.compass.com/development): New luxury developments including The Henry, Willow, Katharine

## Agents & Team

- [Find Real Estate Agents](https://www.compass.com/agents): Find real estate agents by location across multiple US markets
- [Join Compass](https://www.compass.com/agents-compass): Agent recruitment and platform showcasing Compass technology benefits

## Additional Services

- [Compass Concierge](https://www.compass.com/concierge): Concierge services for home staging and improvement financing

## Neighborhood Guides

- [Northern California Guides Hub](https://www.compass.com/neighborhood-guides/sf): Northern California neighborhood guides hub for SF and Bay Area
- [Nob Hill, San Francisco](https://www.compass.com/neighborhood-guides/sf/nob-hill): Nob Hill neighborhood guide with lifestyle, commute, and market info
- [Russian Hill, San Francisco](https://www.compass.com/neighborhood-guides/sf/russian-hill): Russian Hill neighborhood guide covering architecture and lifestyle
- [Pacific Heights, San Francisco](https://www.compass.com/neighborhood-guides/sf/pacific-heights): Pacific Heights luxury neighborhood guide with architecture focus
- [The Mission, San Francisco](https://www.compass.com/neighborhood-guides/sf/the-mission): Mission District guide covering tech hub, dining, and retail scene
- [Marina District, San Francisco](https://www.compass.com/neighborhood-guides/sf/marina-district): Marina District guide with waterfront living and luxury condo info
- [Hayes Valley, San Francisco](https://www.compass.com/neighborhood-guides/sf/hayes-valley): Hayes Valley guide covering boutiques, restaurants, and nightlife
